name: Project Canvas
description: Authoring guidance for Project Canvas boards
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.tagline: Teaches AI sessions how to write .canvas boards
marketplace.longDescription: The Project Canvas editor is built into Nimbalyst. This extension adds the authoring guidance an AI session needs to write a board by hand: the JSON Canvas file format, the x-nimbalyst card references, layout conventions, and edges.
highlights: AI sessions can create canvas boards from a description
Cards that reference real workspace files and shared documents
Layout that lands on the board's grid instead of needing a cleanup pass
